transfer_applicability.source_documented_method: Reauthor a high-density glyph using context-sensitive stroke breaks, topology merges, negative-space redistribution, then inspect four-character weight and recognizability.
transfer_applicability.source_case: 放肆喜欢 / 喜 (repetitive horizontal bars)
transfer_applicability.target_case: 地图以外 / 图 (enclosing radical 囗 and different interior structure)
transfer_applicability.boundary: The seven redundant horizontal strokes in 喜 DO NOT exist in 图; copying author-specific deletion rules to 图 is an invalid analogy. No arbitrary stroke may be removed from 图 to imitate source.
transfer_applicability.new_hypothesis: A cohesive four-glyph composition authored from gesture and structurally meaningful counters before any texture pass, with 图 enclosure handled as a deliberate optical tension rather than an unmodified rectangular box, may improve against old generic-brush versions.
transfer_applicability.intervention_axis: creative glyph topology and cross-character silhouette ONLY; no blind thickness/texture/aspect scaling, and not merely stacking preexisting fonts
visible_decisions_to_test: 地：preserve unmistakable 土 and 也 but align weight and movement with the rest of the mark, not by a pasted font.
图：try a deliberately constructed and still legible enclosing-shape rhythm, not mechanical rectangular-font contour and not deletion of essential interior strokes.
以：use its lower visual density as a structural pause between dense 图 and 外, not random isolated brush dots.
外：redesign its total mass and vertical cadence so its rightmost stroke does not overwhelm the wordmark.
